newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt buys U.S., French, Australian wheat.
newsitem.headline: Egypt buys U.S., French, Australian wheat.

text.p: Egypt's official commodities buyer said on Saturday he had bought 100,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat, 150,000 tonnes of French soft red wheat and 50,000 tonnes of Australian soft white wheat.

Samir Shakankiri, vice chairman of the General Authority for Supply Commodities, told Reuters 50,000 tonnes of the U.S. wheat were bought for $148 per tonne fob and the other 50,000 tonnes for $149.49 per tonnes fob. The period of shipment for both purchases was November 18-30.

He said 50,000 tonnes of the French wheat were bought for $147 per tonne fob for December 1-8 shipment while the other 50,000 tonnes cost $146.5 per tonne fob and would be shipped between December 1-9.
He announced earlier on Saturday that he had bought 50,000 tonnes of French soft red wheat at $147 per tonne fob for November 30 to December 6 shipment.
Shakankiri also said he had bought 50,000 tonnes of Australian soft white wheat for December 1-8 shipment but did disclose the price.
